# code-blocks

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-001 — Colour the tokens of fenced code in a supported language](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-001.md) — When a document contains a fenced code block in a supported language, the extension SHALL colour its keywords, strings, numbers and comments with distinct token colours.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-002 — Resolve common fence labels to a supported grammar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-002.md) — When a fence label is a common alias such as `py`, `js`, `sh`, `rs` or `patch`, the extension SHALL highlight the block with the grammar the alias names.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-003 — Read the fence label case-insensitively up to its first separator](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-003.md) — When a fence label carries upper-case letters or trailing text after a space, a comma or `{`, the extension SHALL select the grammar from the label's leading word, ignoring case.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-004 — Leave unknown-language code as plain text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-004.md) — When a code block's language is unknown or absent, the extension SHALL leave the block as plain monospace text without token spans.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-005 — Wrap numbered, emphasized and diff blocks into lines in any language](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-005.md) — When a numbered, emphasized or diff block has an unknown language, the extension SHALL still wrap it into lines, without the highlight class.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-006 — Show special characters once in highlighted code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-006.md) — When highlighted code contains `<`, `&` or numeric character references, the extension SHALL show each character once, without double escaping.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-007 — Colour code tokens from the VS Code theme](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-007.md) — When a highlighted block is shown, the extension SHALL colour keywords, strings, numbers, additions, titles, attributes, deletions and comments with the matching VS Code chart colours, comments muted and italic.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-008 — Treat diff lines as additions and deletions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-008.md) — When a `diff` or `patch` block is shown, the extension SHALL mark each line starting with `+` as an addition and each line starting with `-` as a deletion, keeping the literal markers.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-009 — Colour diff file header lines like ordinary lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-009.md) — When a diff contains `--- a/file` and `+++ b/file` header lines, the extension SHALL colour them as a deletion and an addition respectively.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-010 — Use system colours for diff lines in forced-colours mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-010.md) — When the page runs in forced-colours mode, the extension SHALL colour diff additions with the system Mark colour and deletions with the system Highlight colour.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-011 — Number and emphasize lines of MyST code directives](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-011.md) — When a MyST `{code}`, `{code-block}` or `{code-cell}` sets a numbering option or `:emphasize-lines:`, the extension SHALL number the lines from the start value and highlight the listed lines relative to it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-012 — Style fenced code blocks with one font scale and the code background](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-012.md) — When a fenced code block is shown, the extension SHALL use the editor foreground colour, a font size of 0.92em, a 4 px radius, a border and the code-block background, with no box of its own on the inner code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-013 — Scroll long code lines inside their block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-013.md) — When a code line is wider than its block outside Auto width mode, the extension SHALL scroll the block horizontally to the line's far end and SHALL NOT widen the page, also at a 460 px panel width.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-014 — Show the file name of a code directive above its code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-014.md) — When a MyST code directive sets `:filename:`, the extension SHALL show the file name above the code in smaller muted text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-015 — Render a captioned code directive as a figure with a reference target](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-015.md) — When a MyST code directive sets `:caption:` and `:label:`, the extension SHALL render a figure with the caption whose id is the label, usable as a `{ref}` target.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-016 — Keep code backgrounds soft and readable in the forced white and cream themes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-016.md) — When the white or cream theme is forced, the extension SHALL give code blocks a soft background and readable text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-017 — Show a Copy code button on hovered code blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-017.md) — When the pointer is over a code block of the preview content, the extension SHALL show a 26 px Copy code button 6 px inside the block's top-right corner.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-018 — Hide the copy button below 30 px of visible block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-018.md) — When less than 30 px of the hovered block is visible below the sticky band or the frame top, the extension SHALL hide the copy button, and SHALL show it again once 30 px are visible.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-019 — Copy the raw code with one click](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-019.md) — When the reader clicks the copy button, the extension SHALL put the block's code only on the clipboard, without file name or line numbers, lines joined with newlines and a trailing newline.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-020 — Confirm a copy with a Copied state for 1.5 seconds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-020.md) — When the reader clicks the copy button, the extension SHALL label the button Copied with a check mark and restore Copy code after 1.5 s.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-021 — Keep focus and editors untouched by the copy button](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-021.md) — When the reader presses the copy button, the extension SHALL keep the focus of an open block editor and SHALL NOT open or commit an editor or let the click reach the block's own click handling.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-022 — Offer no copy button for edited blocks, editors, diagram sources and blocks outside the content](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-022.md) — When a code block is being edited, lies inside a block editor, holds the source of a Mermaid or PlantUML diagram or lies outside the preview content, the extension SHALL NOT show a copy button for it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-023 — Hide the copy button on a click inside the block until the pointer moves](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-023.md) — When the reader clicks inside the hovered code block, the extension SHALL hide the copy button until the pointer moves again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-024 — Hide the copy button when a content patch updates the page](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-024.md) — When a content patch updates the preview in place, the extension SHALL hide the copy button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-025 — Allow copying in read-only previews](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-025.md) — When a preview is read-only because the workspace is untrusted or the file is standalone, the extension SHALL still write the requested code text to the clipboard and edit nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-026 — Refuse an invalid or oversized copy request](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-026.md) — When a copy request carries text that is not a string or is longer than 1 000 000 characters, the extension SHALL refuse it without writing the clipboard and without a message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-027 — Drop a copy request from a stale page](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-027.md) — When a copy request comes from a page whose document version or render request is no longer current, the extension SHALL drop it without writing the clipboard.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-028 — Join a code caption to its block as a title bar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-028.md) — When a MyST code-block has a caption, the extension SHALL keep the code left-aligned and show the caption as a left-aligned monospace title bar joined to the block's top with the same width and border and a square joint.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-029 — Hide the copy button when the pointer leaves the block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-029.md) — When the pointer leaves a code block, the extension SHALL hide the copy button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-030 — Never highlight inline code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-030.md) — When inline code appears outside a preformatted block, the extension SHALL NOT apply syntax highlighting to it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-031 — Show fenced code text literally](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-031.md) — When a fenced code block holds Markdown syntax, inner fences, tables or links, the extension SHALL show that text literally without rendering it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-032 — Hide the copy button when scrolling stops outside the block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-032.md) — When scrolling stops for 120 ms with the pointer outside the hovered block, the extension SHALL hide the copy button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-033 — Reposition the copy button on window resize](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-033.md) — When the window is resized while the copy button is shown, the extension SHALL move the button to the top-right corner of the resized block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-034 — Keep the copy button clear of the sticky band and toolbar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-034.md) — When the default top-right position of the copy button falls under the sticky heading band or the floating toolbar, the extension SHALL place the button below them.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-035 — Reset the Copied state when another block is hovered](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-035.md) — When the pointer enters another code block while the button shows Copied, the extension SHALL reset the button to Copy code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-036 — Show diff blocks as a full-width square panel](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-036.md) — When a `diff` or `patch` block is shown, the extension SHALL display it as a full-width panel with square corners and no border.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-037 — Fall back to escaped text lines when a grammar fails](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-037.md) — When a grammar throws while highlighting a numbered, emphasized or diff block, the extension SHALL show the block's escaped text in wrapped lines.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-038 — Colour YAML code text with the link colour in the forced white and cream themes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-038.md) — When the white or cream theme is forced, the extension SHALL colour YAML code text with the link colour.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
